title: Sanctus (Hesdin, Missa Benedicta es)
desc: Nicolle des Celliers de Hesdin, Missa Benedicta es, Sanctus, c. 1535-1537. 5 voices (Superius, Contratenor, Tenor, Quintus, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
cr: From CRIM, Citations: The Renaissance Imitation Mass (crimproject.org, CRIM_Mass_0029_4); edited by Christina Cassia, Vincent Besson. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0.
